ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.
M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported
e.g., Baseline, 6-Month Follow Up, Year 2; Morning, At Bedtime

ElementDescription: Have you ever experienced serious conflicts with family, friends, or partners because of your phone use?
Have you tried to hide how much you used your phone from family and friends?
Have you spent less time with friends, or doing other activities, in order to use your phone?
Have you had arguments with others about your phone use, but continued to use your phone excessively?
Have there been times when all you could think about was using your phone?
Have you felt the need to use your phone for longer amounts of time?
Have you felt restless or tense when you were unable to use your phone?
Have you used your phone to forget about personal problems or other things that were bothering you?
Have you felt that you should use your phone less, but have been unable to cut back on your phone use?
